The M0.19 row now has FIVE cells against a four-column header (`| ID | Task | Serves | State |`): `| M0.19 | <task> | - AND `prefixFor` KEYS ON THE JAR FILENAME... | - | todo |`. GFM ignores cells past the header width, so the row RENDERS as Serves = the prefixFor essay and State = `-`, with `todo` dropped entirely. A reader (or the `next-task` skill) scanning the State column sees no state for an open row, and the Serves column carries prose where every other row carries an FR/NFR id. check-session-load.sh does not catch it because it reads `cells[-1]`, the last cell, not the fourth. Fix is one character: replace the `|` before `- AND` with a space so the note joins the Task cell. (Two rows already have stray cells - M0.55 and M4.31 - but those are unescaped `||` and `|` inside code spans, not a hand-written extra column.)
